# setup

Builds one self-contained HTML file (no server, no internet needed) to browse the prioritized TCRs of every patient:
choose patient, compartment and clonotype, and the cells of that clonotype are highlighted on the UMAP of each
condition, coloured by Seurat cluster, as in the static `IC11_*_prioritized_TCRs` figures. Tier, Level and the rest
of the prioritization table are shown next to the plots.

Inputs, per patient and compartment (both written by `deconv-analysis*.Rmd`):

- `patients/<patient>/deconv/tcr/prioritized_<compartment>_tcrs_for_validation.tsv`
- `patients/<patient>/deconv/seurat/obj_<compartment>_TCR.rds`

A second block shows the single-cell data of the TILs (`til-data/`, all patients): the cells carrying the selected
clonotype on the TIL UMAP, next to the TIL clusters, the patients and two rows of lineage, exhaustion and memory markers
(protein and RNA). It needs the `TIL_sc_*` columns written by `til-frequency.Rmd`, so run that script first.

Output: `patients/prioritized_tcrs_umap_viewer.html`

The Seurat objects are large (up to ~2.6 GB on disk): run this on a compute node, not on the front end.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- Define paths ---
# --- Locate the project folder: works from renv-sturcotte/ (scripts/interactive-R.sh) and from the folder of this script ---
project_dir <- getwd()
while (!file.exists(file.path(project_dir, "setup", "setup-m1.R")) && dirname(project_dir) != project_dir) {
  project_dir <- dirname(project_dir)
}
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(project_dir, "setup", "setup-m1.R")))
datapath <- file.path(project_dir, "patients")
folder_data <- "deconv"
template_file <- file.path(project_dir, "scripts", "reports", "tcr-umap-viewer-template.html")
output_file <- file.path(datapath, "prioritized_tcrs_umap_viewer.html")
# --- Parameters ---
patients_sel <- NULL                  # NULL = every patient with a prioritization table; or e.g. c("pt3385", "pt3513")
cluster_column <- "SCT_snn_res.0.5"   # clustering used to colour the cells (same as the IC11 figures)
reduction <- "umap"
coord_quant <- 4095L                  # UMAP coordinates are stored as integers in 0..coord_quant to keep the file small
# --- TIL single-cell data (set til_file <- NULL to leave the TIL block out) ---
til_file <- file.path(project_dir, "til-data", "cite1_2_3_4_5_6_8_withoutPat400304_TCR_ADT_virus_singlets.rds")
til_reduction <- "umap.cca"
til_min_cells <- 2    # TIL clonotypes with at least this many cells are listed in the dropdown (all are searchable)
bulk_file <- file.path(datapath, "clonotypes_adaptive_bulk_productivefreqs_update.rds")   # same file as in petasan .../sturcotte/tcrb/
phenotype_column <- "functional.cluster"   # ProjecTILs annotation used in the <condition>_phenotype columns
til_cluster_column <- "clusters_old"
# Markers painted on the TIL UMAP: one row of proteins (ADT assay, CITE-seq antibodies) and one row of genes
# (SCT assay), shown in this order; the first four are the same markers in both rows
til_markers <- data.frame(
  label = c("CD4", "CD8", "PD-1 (CD279)", "CD39", "TIM-3 (CD366)", "4-1BB (CD137)", "CD103", "CD127 (IL-7Ra)",
            "CD4", "CD8A", "PDCD1 (PD-1)", "ENTPD1 (CD39)", "CXCL13", "TOX", "TCF7", "GZMK"),
  group = c("lineage", "lineage", "exhaustion", "exhaustion", "exhaustion", "activation / tumour reactivity", "tissue residency", "memory",
            "lineage", "lineage", "exhaustion", "exhaustion", "exhaustion / tumour reactivity", "exhaustion", "stem-like / pre-exhausted", "pre-exhausted / effector memory"),
  assay = c(rep("ADT", 8), rep("SCT", 8)),
  feature = c("anti-human-CD4", "anti-human-CD8", "anti-human-CD279", "anti-human-CD39",
              "TotalSeq-C0169 anti-human CD366 (Tim-3) Antibody", "anti-human-CD137-4-1BB",
              "anti-human-CD103-Integrin-aE", "anti-human-CD127-IL-7Ra",
              "CD4", "CD8A", "PDCD1", "ENTPD1", "CXCL13", "TOX", "TCF7", "GZMK")
)
# --- Load libraries ---
library(SeuratObject)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)
```

# inputs

One row per prioritization table found.

```{r}
tables <- list.files(
  datapath,
  pattern = "^prioritized_.*_tcrs_for_validation\\.tsv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
tables <- tables[basename(dirname(tables)) == "tcr" & basename(dirname(dirname(tables))) == folder_data]
inputs <- data.frame(
  patient = basename(dirname(dirname(dirname(tables)))),
  compartment = sub("^prioritized_(.*)_tcrs_for_validation\\.tsv$", "\\1", basename(tables)),
  table = tables
)
inputs$seurat <- file.path(datapath, inputs$patient, folder_data, "seurat", paste0("obj_", inputs$compartment, "_TCR.rds"))
if (!is.null(patients_sel)) {
  inputs <- inputs[inputs$patient %in% patients_sel, , drop = FALSE]
}
missing_objects <- !file.exists(inputs$seurat)
if (any(missing_objects)) {
  warning("Seurat object not found, skipped: ", paste(inputs$seurat[missing_objects], collapse = ", "))
  inputs <- inputs[!missing_objects, , drop = FALSE]
}
stopifnot(nrow(inputs) > 0)
inputs[, c("patient", "compartment")]
```

# tils

UMAP coordinates, patient, sorted fraction, cluster, TCR keys and marker levels of every cell of the TIL object.
Marker levels are the normalized values of the assay, rescaled to 0-255 between the 1st and the 99th percentile
of all cells (RNA: between 0 and the 99th percentile).

```{r}
# --- Rescale a coordinate to integers in 0..coord_quant ---
quantize <- function(v) {
  rng <- range(v)
  as.integer(round((v - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1]) * coord_quant))
}
til <- NULL
til_md <- NULL
if (!is.null(til_file)) {
  obj <- readRDS(til_file)
  til_md <- obj[[]]
  stopifnot(all(c("patient_id", "subset_id", "clonotype", "cdr3_j", til_cluster_column) %in% colnames(til_md)))
  emb <- SeuratObject::Embeddings(obj, reduction = til_reduction)[rownames(til_md), 1:2]
  markers <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(til_markers)), function(i) {
    values <- SeuratObject::LayerData(obj, assay = til_markers$assay[i], layer = "data")[til_markers$feature[i], rownames(til_md)]
    low <- if (til_markers$assay[i] == "ADT") stats::quantile(values, 0.01) else 0
    high <- stats::quantile(values, 0.99)
    if (high <= low) high <- max(values)
    list(
      label = til_markers$label[i],
      group = til_markers$group[i],
      source = if (til_markers$assay[i] == "ADT") "protein (ADT)" else "RNA (SCT)",
      feature = til_markers$feature[i],
      v = as.integer(round(255 * pmin(pmax((values - low) / (high - low), 0), 1)))
    )
  })
  rm(obj)
  invisible(gc())
  til_patients <- sort(unique(til_md$patient_id))
  til_subsets <- c("PD1p", "PD1d")
  til_clusters <- levels(factor(til_md[[til_cluster_column]]))
  stopifnot(all(til_md$subset_id %in% til_subsets))
  til <- list(
    reduction = til_reduction,
    cluster_column = til_cluster_column,
    source = sub(paste0("^", project_dir, "/"), "", til_file),
    patients = I(til_patients),
    patient_colors = I(scales::hue_pal(l = 60, c = 110, h.start = 40)(length(til_patients))),
    subsets = I(til_subsets),
    clusters = I(til_clusters),
    colors = I(scales::hue_pal()(length(til_clusters))),
    x = quantize(emb[, 1]),
    y = quantize(emb[, 2]),
    patient = match(til_md$patient_id, til_patients) - 1L,
    subset = match(til_md$subset_id, til_subsets) - 1L,
    clus = match(as.character(til_md[[til_cluster_column]]), til_clusters) - 1L,
    markers = markers
  )
  cat("TIL cells:", nrow(til_md), "| patients:", length(til_patients), "| markers:", paste(til_markers$label, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
# --- TIL cells of each clonotype of a table (0-based indices), from the TIL_sc_* columns of til-frequency.Rmd ---
til_cells_of <- function(patient, tcr_table) {
  if (is.null(til_md) || !all(c("TIL_sc", "TIL_sc_matched_by", "TIL_sc_match_key") %in% colnames(tcr_table))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  in_patient <- til_md$patient_id == paste0("CHUM_", sub("^pt", "", patient))
  cells <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(tcr_table)), function(i) {
    key <- tcr_table$TIL_sc_match_key[i]
    basis <- tcr_table$TIL_sc_matched_by[i]
    if (is.na(key)) {
      return(integer(0))
    }
    til_key <- if (startsWith(basis, "CDR3b")) til_md$cdr3_j else if (startsWith(basis, "clonotype ID")) til_md$clonotype else stop("Unknown match basis: ", basis)
    which(in_patient & !is.na(til_key) & til_key == key) - 1L
  })
  # --- Internal control: same number of cells as in the table ---
  expected <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("/.*$", "", tcr_table$TIL_sc)))
  stopifnot(identical(lengths(cells)[!is.na(expected)], expected[!is.na(expected)]), all(lengths(cells)[is.na(expected)] == 0))
  lapply(cells, I)
}
```

# til clonotypes

Besides the clonotypes of the prioritization table, the viewer knows every TIL clonotype of the patient, to see
whether it was found ex vivo and whether it is activated. They can be found with the search box (by clonotype
number or name), and those with at least `til_min_cells` TIL cells are also listed in the dropdown, after the clonotypes of the table. They are
labelled Tier "TIL clonotype" and, as responding condition, "Non prioritized" plus their status:

- **no significant response ex vivo**: found ex vivo (same matching rule as `til-frequency.Rmd`: CDR3 beta
  nucleotide sequence + TRBJ where the deconvolution object has sequences, clonotype identifier shared with the
  bulk table otherwise). One entry per ex vivo clonotype not already in the table, with its activation in every
  condition recomputed exactly as in `deconv-analysis.Rmd` (99th percentile of Unpulsed, one-sided binomial test,
  BH within condition). They are not in the table because they have no significant response to Pept_pool or to
  any R condition.
- **not detected ex vivo**: entry named `TIL <clonotype>`, with TIL panels only.
- **cannot be matched ex vivo** (objects without sequences, identifier absent from the bulk table): idem.

These entries exist only in the viewer; the prioritization tables are not modified.

```{r}
bulk <- if (!is.null(til_file)) readRDS(bulk_file) else NULL
# --- Most frequent beta-chain key (CDR3 nt + TRBJ) of each clonotype, as in til-frequency.Rmd ---
beta_keys <- function(md, id_column) {
  md <- md[!is.na(md[[id_column]]), c(id_column, "chains", "cdr3_nt", "j_gene")]
  keys <- Map(
    function(chain, nt, j) {
      if (anyNA(c(chain, nt, j))) {
        return(character(0))
      }
      chain <- trimws(strsplit(chain, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      nt <- trimws(strsplit(nt, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      j <- trimws(strsplit(j, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      if (length(chain) != length(nt) || length(nt) != length(j)) {
        return(character(0))
      }
      beta_idx <- which(chain == "TRB" & grepl("^TRBJ", j) & grepl("^[ACGT]+$", nt))
      paste0(nt[beta_idx], "_", sub("\\*.*$", "", j[beta_idx]))
    },
    md$chains, md$cdr3_nt, md$j_gene
  )
  long <- data.frame(
    id = rep(as.character(md[[id_column]]), lengths(keys)),
    cdr3_j = unlist(keys, use.names = FALSE)
  )
  counts <- stats::aggregate(Freq ~ id + cdr3_j, data = cbind(long, Freq = 1L), FUN = sum)
  counts <- counts[order(counts$id, -counts$Freq, counts$cdr3_j), ]
  counts <- counts[!duplicated(counts$id), ]
  stats::setNames(counts$cdr3_j, counts$id)
}
decimal_comma <- function(x) sub(".", ",", as.character(x), fixed = TRUE)
# --- Activation of every clonotype in every condition, as in deconv-analysis.Rmd ---
condition_stats <- function(md, id_column, conditions) {
  ids <- factor(as.character(md[[id_column]]))
  sample <- factor(as.character(md$sample_id), levels = conditions)
  threshold <- stats::quantile(md$activation_UCell[sample == "Unpulsed"], 0.99)
  activated <- md$activation_UCell > threshold
  p0 <- max(mean(activated[sample == "Unpulsed"]), 0.01)
  n <- unclass(table(ids, sample))
  act <- unclass(table(ids[activated], sample[activated]))
  p <- stats::pbinom(act - 1, n, p0, lower.tail = FALSE)   # binom.test(act, n, p0, alternative = "greater")
  p[n < 2] <- NA
  padj <- apply(p, 2, stats::p.adjust, method = "BH")
  activation <- ifelse(n > 0, sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", act, n, 100 * act / pmax(n, 1)), NA_character_)
  dim(activation) <- dim(n)
  padj_text <- decimal_comma(signif(padj, 2))
  dim(padj_text) <- dim(n)
  dimnames(activation) <- dimnames(padj_text) <- dimnames(n)
  list(activation = activation, padj = padj_text)
}
# --- Most frequent state of a clonotype in a condition: "state (pct%)", "ND" without cells ---
main_state <- function(states) {
  if (length(states) == 0) {
    return("ND")
  }
  counts <- table(trimws(as.character(states)))
  counts <- counts[names(counts) != ""]
  if (length(counts) == 0) {
    return("Unannotated")
  }
  top <- sort(names(counts)[counts == max(counts)])
  paste(sprintf("%s (%d%%)", top, round(100 * max(counts) / length(states))), collapse = " or ")
}
til_tier <- "TIL clonotype"
til_groups <- c(
  exvivo = "Non prioritized (no significant response ex vivo)",
  absent = "Non prioritized (not detected ex vivo)",
  unmatched = "Non prioritized (cannot be matched ex vivo)"
)
# --- Prioritization table plus one row per TIL clonotype that is not in it (same columns, as text) ---
til_extended_table <- function(patient, compartment, tcr_table, md, conditions) {
  if (is.null(til_md) || !all(c("TIL_sc", "TIL_sc_matched_by", "TIL_sc_match_key") %in% colnames(tcr_table))) {
    return(tcr_table)
  }
  id_column <- colnames(tcr_table)[1]
  til_patient <- paste0("CHUM_", sub("^pt", "", patient))
  til_pt <- til_md[til_md$patient_id == til_patient & !is.na(til_md$clonotype) & !is.na(til_md$cdr3_j), ]
  bulk_pt <- bulk[[til_patient]]
  stopifnot(nrow(til_pt) > 0, !is.null(bulk_pt))
  pairs <- unique(til_pt[, c("clonotype", "cdr3_j")])
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pairs$clonotype), !anyDuplicated(pairs$cdr3_j))
  use_sequence <- all(c("chains", "cdr3_nt", "j_gene") %in% colnames(md))
  til_key_column <- if (use_sequence) "cdr3_j" else "clonotype"
  # --- Clonotype identifier in the TIL data of the clonotypes of the table (searchable in the viewer) ---
  tcr_table$TIL_sc_clonotype <- if (use_sequence) {
    pairs$clonotype[match(tcr_table$TIL_sc_match_key, pairs$cdr3_j)]
  } else {
    ifelse(tcr_table$TIL_sc_match_key %in% pairs$clonotype, tcr_table$TIL_sc_match_key, NA_character_)
  }
  exvivo_key <- if (use_sequence) beta_keys(md, id_column) else {
    ids <- unique(as.character(md[[id_column]]))
    stats::setNames(ifelse(ids %in% bulk_pt$clonotype, ids, NA_character_), ids)
  }
  # --- TIL counts and ranks, overall and per sorted fraction (as in til-frequency.Rmd) ---
  til_counts <- lapply(c(TIL_sc = "all", TIL_sc_PD1p = "PD1p", TIL_sc_PD1d = "PD1d"), function(subset) {
    cells <- if (subset == "all") rep(TRUE, nrow(til_pt)) else til_pt$subset_id == subset
    counts <- table(til_pt[[til_key_column]][cells])
    list(counts = counts, ranks = rank(-counts, ties.method = "min"), total = sum(cells))
  })
  for (column in names(til_counts)) {
    stopifnot(paste0(column, "_rank (N=", length(til_counts[[column]]$counts), ")") %in% colnames(tcr_table))
  }
  # --- Bulk TCRb frequencies and ranks among productive clonotypes (as in deconv-analysis.Rmd) ---
  bulk_columns <- c(Tumor = "tumor", Blood = "blood", PE = "PE", Bulk = "bulk", TIDAL01 = "TIDAL01")
  bulk_columns <- bulk_columns[paste0(names(bulk_columns), "_freq") %in% colnames(tcr_table)]
  bulk_productive <- unique(bulk_pt[bulk_pt$productive == "yes", c("clonotype", "cdr3_j", unname(bulk_columns))])
  bulk_key <- bulk_productive[[til_key_column]]
  bulk_distinct <- !duplicated(bulk_productive$clonotype)   # ranks over distinct productive clonotypes
  # --- TIL clonotypes with enough cells, and the ex vivo clonotypes carrying them ---
  selected <- names(til_counts$TIL_sc$counts)
  stats <- condition_stats(md, id_column, conditions)
  new_row <- function(id, status, key, matched_by, til_name) {
    row <- stats::setNames(as.list(rep(NA_character_, ncol(tcr_table))), colnames(tcr_table))
    row[[id_column]] <- id
    row$Prioritize <- "FALSE"
    row$Tier <- til_tier
    row$Condition <- status
    row$TIL_sc_clonotype <- til_name
    for (column in names(til_counts)) {
      x <- til_counts[[column]]
      n <- if (key %in% names(x$counts)) as.integer(x$counts[[key]]) else 0L
      row[[column]] <- sprintf("%d/%d (%.2f%%)", n, x$total, 100 * n / x$total)
      row[[paste0(column, "_rank (N=", length(x$counts), ")")]] <- if (n > 0) as.character(as.integer(x$ranks[[key]])) else NA_character_
    }
    row$TIL_sc_matched_by <- matched_by
    row$TIL_sc_match_key <- key
    hit <- which(bulk_key == key)
    if (length(hit) == 1) {
      for (name in names(bulk_columns)) {
        values <- bulk_productive[[bulk_columns[[name]]]]
        if (!is.na(values[hit]) && values[hit] > 0) {
          rank_column <- grep(paste0("^", name, "_rank \\(N="), colnames(tcr_table), value = TRUE)
          row[[paste0(name, "_freq")]] <- decimal_comma(values[hit])
          row[[rank_column]] <- as.character(sum(values[bulk_distinct] > values[hit], na.rm = TRUE) + 1L)
        }
      }
    }
    row
  }
  rows <- list()
  cells_by_id <- split(seq_len(nrow(md)), as.character(md[[id_column]]))
  for (key in selected) {   # key: cdr3_j (objects with sequences) or clonotype identifier
    til_name <- if (use_sequence) pairs$clonotype[pairs$cdr3_j == key] else key
    matchable <- use_sequence || key %in% bulk_pt$clonotype
    exvivo_ids <- if (matchable) names(exvivo_key)[!is.na(exvivo_key) & exvivo_key == key] else character(0)
    if (any(exvivo_ids %in% tcr_table[[id_column]])) {
      exvivo_ids <- setdiff(exvivo_ids, tcr_table[[id_column]])   # already listed with the prioritization table
      if (length(exvivo_ids) == 0) next
    }
    if (length(exvivo_ids) == 0) {
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- new_row(
        paste("TIL", til_name),
        if (matchable) til_groups[["absent"]] else til_groups[["unmatched"]],
        key,
        if (use_sequence) "CDR3b nucleotide sequence + TRBJ" else if (matchable) "clonotype ID (shared with the bulk TCRb table)" else
          "clonotype ID of the TIL data; absent from the bulk TCRb table, so it cannot be searched in the ex vivo data",
        til_name
      )
      next
    }
    for (id in exvivo_ids) {
      row <- new_row(id, til_groups[["exvivo"]], key,
                     if (use_sequence) "CDR3b nucleotide sequence + TRBJ" else "clonotype ID (shared with the bulk TCRb table)",
                     til_name)
      for (condition in conditions) {
        cells <- cells_by_id[[id]][as.character(md$sample_id[cells_by_id[[id]]]) == condition]
        row[[condition]] <- stats$activation[id, condition]
        row[[paste0(condition, "_padj")]] <- stats$padj[id, condition]
        row[[paste0(condition, "_cluster")]] <- main_state(md[[cluster_column]][cells])
        if (phenotype_column %in% colnames(md)) {
          row[[paste0(condition, "_phenotype")]] <- main_state(md[[phenotype_column]][cells])
        }
      }
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  # --- Internal control: the recomputed statistics reproduce the prioritization table ---
  tabled <- intersect(tcr_table[[id_column]], rownames(stats$activation))
  same <- function(a, b) (is.na(a) & is.na(b)) | (!is.na(a) & !is.na(b) & a == b)
  agree_activation <- unlist(lapply(conditions, function(x) same(tcr_table[match(tabled, tcr_table[[id_column]]), x], stats$activation[tabled, x])))
  agree_padj <- unlist(lapply(conditions, function(x) same(tcr_table[match(tabled, tcr_table[[id_column]]), paste0(x, "_padj")], stats$padj[tabled, x])))
  cat(patient, compartment, "| TIL clonotypes:", length(selected),
      "| control vs table: activation", sum(agree_activation), "/", length(agree_activation),
      ", padj", sum(agree_padj), "/", length(agree_padj), "\n")
  if (length(rows) == 0) {
    return(tcr_table)
  }
  extra <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, lapply(rows, unlist)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(extra) <- colnames(tcr_table)
  extra <- extra[order(match(extra$Condition, til_groups), -as.integer(sub("/.*$", "", extra$TIL_sc))), , drop = FALSE]
  print(table(extra$Condition))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(c(tcr_table[[id_column]], extra[[id_column]])))
  rbind(tcr_table, extra)
}
```

# extract

For each patient and compartment: UMAP coordinates, condition, cluster and clonotype of every cell, plus the
prioritization table. The first column of the table (`TCR_ID` or `clonotype`, depending on the patient) is also
the name of the metadata column that identifies the clonotype of each cell.

```{r}
# --- Condition order: Unpulsed, CD3CD28, Pept_pool, then R conditions in numeric order ---
order_conditions <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(as.character(x))
  r_conditions <- grep("^R[0-9]+$", x, value = TRUE)
  r_conditions <- r_conditions[order(as.numeric(sub("^R", "", r_conditions)))]
  fixed <- intersect(c("Unpulsed", "CD3CD28", "Pept_pool"), x)
  c(fixed, r_conditions, setdiff(x, c(fixed, r_conditions)))
}
extract_dataset <- function(patient, compartment, table_file, seurat_file) {
  message("--- ", patient, " / ", compartment, " ---")
  # --- Prioritization table, kept as text exactly as written ---
  tcr_table <- read.delim(table_file, colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
  id_column <- colnames(tcr_table)[1]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tcr_table[[id_column]]))
  # --- Cell-level data ---
  obj <- readRDS(seurat_file)
  md <- obj[[]]
  stopifnot(
    id_column %in% colnames(md),
    cluster_column %in% colnames(md),
    "sample_id" %in% colnames(md)
  )
  emb <- SeuratObject::Embeddings(obj, reduction = reduction)[rownames(md), 1:2]
  rm(obj)
  invisible(gc())
  conditions <- order_conditions(md$sample_id)
  # --- TIL clonotypes that are not in the table (viewer only) ---
  tcr_table <- til_extended_table(patient, compartment, tcr_table, md, conditions)
  # --- Cluster levels and colours as in DimPlot(group.by = cluster_column): default hue palette ---
  cluster_levels <- levels(factor(md[[cluster_column]]))
  cluster_colors <- scales::hue_pal()(length(cluster_levels))
  clone_index <- match(as.character(md[[id_column]]), tcr_table[[id_column]]) - 1L
  clone_index[is.na(clone_index)] <- -1L
  # --- Internal controls ---
  not_found <- setdiff(tcr_table[[id_column]][tcr_table$Tier != til_tier], as.character(md[[id_column]]))   # TIL-only entries have no ex vivo cells
  if (length(not_found) > 0) {
    warning(patient, " / ", compartment, ": clonotypes of the table without cells in the object: ",
            paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
  }
  missing_columns <- setdiff(conditions, colnames(tcr_table))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    warning(patient, " / ", compartment, ": conditions without a column in the table: ",
            paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
  cat(patient, compartment, "| cells:", nrow(md), "| conditions:", paste(conditions, collapse = ", "),
      "| clusters:", length(cluster_levels), "| clonotypes in table:", nrow(tcr_table),
      "| cells of those clonotypes:", sum(clone_index >= 0), "\n")
  list(
    patient = patient,
    compartment = compartment,
    source = sub(paste0("^", project_dir, "/"), "", table_file),
    cluster_column = cluster_column,
    conditions = I(conditions),
    clusters = I(cluster_levels),
    colors = I(cluster_colors),
    x = quantize(emb[, 1]),
    y = quantize(emb[, 2]),
    cond = match(as.character(md$sample_id), conditions) - 1L,
    clus = match(as.character(md[[cluster_column]]), cluster_levels) - 1L,
    clone = clone_index,
    til_cells = til_cells_of(patient, tcr_table),
    table = list(
      columns = I(colnames(tcr_table)),
      rows = unname(as.matrix(tcr_table))
    )
  )
}
datasets <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(inputs)), function(i) {
  extract_dataset(inputs$patient[i], inputs$compartment[i], inputs$table[i], inputs$seurat[i])
})
```

# html

The data are embedded as JSON in the HTML template (`scripts/reports/tcr-umap-viewer-template.html`), which contains the
page layout and the drawing code.

```{r}
viewer_data <- list(
  generated = format(Sys.Date()),
  quant = coord_quant,
  til_min_cells = til_min_cells,
  til = til,
  datasets = datasets
)
json <- jsonlite::toJSON(viewer_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", digits = NA)
# --- "</" must not appear inside a <script> block ---
json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", json, fixed = TRUE)
template <- paste(readLines(template_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
placeholder <- "/*__DATA__*/"
parts <- strsplit(template, placeholder, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
stopifnot(length(parts) == 2)
con <- file(output_file, open = "wb")
writeLines(c(parts[1], json, parts[2]), con, sep = "", useBytes = TRUE)
close(con)
cat("Written:", output_file, "(", round(file.size(output_file) / 1024^2, 1), "MB )\n")
```
